arrays.description: List of MD RAID arrays to configure. Each entry defines an array to monitor, assemble, or create.

level.description: RAID level (e.g., raid0, raid1, raid4, raid5, raid6, linear, multipath)

uuid.description: UUID of the array (e.g., 'a1b2c3d4:e5f6:7890:abcd:ef1234567890'; leave blank if auto-detected)

items.description: Path to a member disk partition or device

metadata.description: Metadata version used on the array (e.g., '1.0', '1.1', '1.2', 'ddf', 'imsm')

MAILADDR.description: Email address (or comma-separated list) to send RAID alerts to (e.g., 'admin@example.com')

PROGRAM.description: Command or script to execute when RAID events occur (e.g., log to syslog, send webhook)

MONITOR.description: Enable or disable mdadm monitoring daemon (true = enable monitoring, false = disable)

CHECK_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between RAID health checks (minimum 5; lower values = more responsive but higher CPU load)

SPARE_DELAY.description: Seconds to wait before automatically using a spare disk after a failure (prevents thrashing)

SPARE_GROUPS.description: Number of spare disks to reserve per array (0 = no spares; -1 = auto-spare all arrays)

CREATE_SYMLINKS.description: Create device symlinks (e.g., /dev/md/raid1) for easier reference in scripts and fstab

HOMEHOST.description: Home host policy: 'any' (accept arrays from any host), <hostname> (strict host binding), or 'none'

SCAN.description: Scan scope for array detection: 'all' (scan all devices), 'md' (only MD devices), 'part' (only partitions), or 'none' (no auto-scan)
